origin.basis: Bontrager is Trek Bicycle Corporation's component brand (Trek US store footer).

manufacturing.basis: The Trek product page does not state where the tire is made.

availability.note: Listed in Trek's US store, but the black option showed as unavailable on 2026-11-01; other regions not checked.

name: AW3 Hard-Case Lite
positioning: All-conditions Bontrager road clincher with strong flat protection and a long-lasting tread.
caveats: Trek promises confidence in all conditions but makes no specific wet-grip claim; no wet test recorded.

image.shown: Black AW3 Hard-Case Lite as shown in Trek's primary product photo; one photo covers every width.
image.alt: Bontrager AW3 Hard-Case Lite road tire with black sidewall, standing upright

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-03 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list in a browser (the newest 15 per page when more exist), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out.

checks.note: Only the AW3 Hard-Case is listed
